# Checkgrow

> Checkgrow is a go-to-market engine that learns your product, buyers, market and channels. It connects company knowledge, market research, day-to-day marketing execution and measurement into one system, so every team works from the same context and every campaign starts from what the business already knows. Positioning: AI Native Growth Marketing. Built for CMOs, enterprise marketing teams, marketing and sales operations, growth teams and founders.

Key facts:
- One platform (€79/month at launch) covering what typically takes eleven marketing subscriptions (~€1,199/month).
- A persistent Knowledge Centre (brand, products, audience, numbers) that every AI agent, campaign and report reads from; every result feeds back in.
- Four verticals: Operations (Dashboard, AI Assistant, AI Agents, Tasks), Marketing (Campaigns, Social Media, Content, Website, Tracking), Sales (Companies, Sales, Leads), Research & Reporting (Competitors, Insights).
- Integrates GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Instagram, LinkedIn and n8n; works across OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude and Perplexity with no model lock-in.
- Customers own their data and knowledge; no lock-ins.
- Rated 4.4 (Excellent) on Trustpilot from 12 reviews.

- [Tutorials](https://checkgrow.com/tutorials): Practical video guides for using Checkgrow.

- [Home](https://checkgrow.com/): value proposition, the platform film, the problem it solves, how the system works (Knowledge Centre + four verticals), real customer stories with metrics, use cases in practice, integrations, who it's for, the 11-tool cost comparison, FAQ, and the waitlist signup.
- [Full content for LLMs](https://checkgrow.com/llms-full.txt): the complete site content in plain markdown.

## Use cases

- Knowledge Centre: Explain the business once. Never again. Google Drive, Notion, Slack and your website become structured marketing knowledge (ICPs, buyer personas, products, brand voice, SEO keywords) that every feature reads; update it by chatting and approve the AI's drafts.
- Insights: Ask a question. Get the report. GA4, Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn Ads connected through integrations and MCP; smart reports with AI takeaways and events mapped to TOFU, MOFU and BOFU, with no dashboards to build.
- Campaigns: From strategy to KPIs, in one record. Budget split and KPI targets set from the strategy, every channel's live results in one table, and creators, fees and UTM links managed inside the campaign.
- Creative Studio: Creatives that already know your brand. Generate ad variations from campaign optimisations, competitor ads, your library and market trends with the AI model you prefer, then optimise underperforming ads from live data.
- Competitors: Every competitor move, as it happens. Active LinkedIn and Meta ads, website, pricing, launch and hiring changes tracked automatically, with competitor ads usable as creative references.
- AI Assistant: One chat for everything Checkgrow knows. Multi-model chat (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Perplexity) grounded in your knowledge, campaigns and data, with actions across features straight from the answer.

## Problems Checkgrow answers

- Reporting: CAC buried in spreadsheets, four-tab dashboards, CSV exports on Sunday nights. Checkgrow gives instant AI insights, one-click funnel reads and board-ready dashboards without a data analyst.
- Campaign speed: launch in hours, not weeks. One brief becomes Meta and Google strategies, brainstorms, creatives and deployment; from insight to live ad the same afternoon.
- AI context: ChatGPT doesn't know your product. Checkgrow's agents already know your brand, products and ICP, so every marketer works from one context instead of re-explaining the business per prompt.
- Tracking: priority events set once, every event clear in seconds, no budget lost to broken tracking or clicks that never convert.
- Team leverage: a growth team of three operating like thirty; marketing ops without a dedicated PM; growth marketing without the agency invoice.
- Product-marketing sync: features ship weekly, campaigns keep up; every release becomes a campaign, and ads update when the product changes.
